question: How many pedestrians were killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes each year from 2013 to 2025?

initial_plan.answerability: yes: the dataset includes crash year and the number of pedestrians killed per crash, so the recorded annual total can be summed
initial_plan.metric: Sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed for crashes in each calendar year
initial_plan.denominator: Not applicable; this is a count, not a rate or share
initial_plan.population: All police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes with a crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025, regardless of borough or crash characteristics
initial_plan.years: 2013-2025 inclusive, grouped by calendar year of crash_date

data_check_implications_and_decisions.findings: The population has 2,132,218 crash rows across the requested years, with rows in every year. crash_date is not missing in the selected population, and no selected dates equal the checked default dates 0001-01-01, 1900-01-01, or 1970-01-01. No rows have missing crash_date anywhere in the file. number_of_pedestrians_killed is not missing on any selected row. Each year has date bounds from January 1 through December 31, including 2025.
data_check_implications_and_decisions.row_handling: Keep all rows in the requested date range. No rows are dropped or counted differently for missing dates, default-date values, or missing pedestrian-fatality counts; no separate missing group is needed.
data_check_implications_and_decisions.changes: No changes to the initial plan.

final_plan.answerability: yes: sum the recorded number of pedestrians killed across all police-reported crashes in each requested calendar year
final_plan.denominator: Not applicable; absolute count, not a rate or share
final_plan.population: All police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes with nonmissing crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025, including all boroughs and crash characteristics
final_plan.years: 2013-2025 inclusive; observed date bounds cover January 1 through December 31 in every year
final_plan.missing_value_decision: Keep all selected crash rows; all have nonmissing number_of_pedestrians_killed and crash_date, so none are excluded or separately grouped.
final_plan.limitations: These are recorded counts from police-reported crashes, not an independently validated census of all deaths. Date bounds span every calendar year, but the check cannot establish whether reporting or the dataset is otherwise complete.
